name: discovery_checks_v1

DISCOVERY_ACCURACY_R2.meaning: A reported law is accurate when its R-squared on noise-free rows held back from the fit is at least this; below it the law is wrong. It defines 'wrong' and 'inaccurate' in every discovery benchmark.

defined_before_as: apedp_dyn/discovery_l2/vouching.py POWER = canonical TEMPORAL_RATE_CALIBRATION_POWER_MIN, a threshold for calibrating temporal rate models
LAST_CHECKS_MIN_POWER.meaning: The power the last checks must have against an error large enough to make a law wrong; with less, the law is withheld.

defined_before_as: apedp_dyn/discovery_l2/vouching.py LEVEL = canonical DIEBOLD_MARIANO_P_VALUE_THRESHOLD, a threshold for comparing forecasts
LAST_CHECKS_TEST_LEVEL.meaning: The family level at which the last checks' tests refuse a law; the second version runs two tests at half of it each.

defined_before_as: the 95 % of the upper bounds reported beside earlier results, with no criterion attached
REPORTED_WRONG_SHARE_BOUND_CONFIDENCE.meaning: The confidence of the one-sided exact (Clopper-Pearson) upper bound on the share of wrong laws among those reported.

defined_before_as: nothing: until 2026-11-25 a share inside REPORTED_WRONG_SHARE_MAX passed whatever its upper bound (2 wrong of 44 passed with a bound of 13.6 %)
REPORTED_WRONG_SHARE_BOUND_MAX.meaning: The upper bound on the share of wrong laws among those reported must be at most this before the share counts as shown. With the share inside REPORTED_WRONG_SHARE_MAX and the bound above this, the test decides nothing on the point.

defined_before_as: canonical REFEREE_MAX_FPR, a referee's allowed share of false positives, borrowed by five plans up to PREREG-REAL-TABLES-2026-11
REPORTED_WRONG_SHARE_MAX.meaning: Of the laws a method reports in a test, at most this share may be wrong, that is, not accurate by DISCOVERY_ACCURACY_R2. A larger share misses.

what: Thresholds of the discovery routes' last checks and of their benchmarks, each named by what it means. Until 2026-11-23 the accuracy line was a bare literal in three files and the checks' level and power were borrowed from canonical-spec entries defined for other tests; those values are unchanged. On 2026-11-25, by the owner's decision, the limit on the share of wrong laws among those reported was named here (it had been borrowed from the referee's allowed share of false positives, with the same value) and a second condition was added for plans frozen from that date: the upper bound of that share. Loaded by apedp_dyn/conf/discovery_checks.py, which checks this file's SHA-256. Not covered by the signed governance manifest until the trustees sign it.
